# YourGP@Lyneham — Full Site Content

> General practice in Lyneham, Canberra — Genuine Care, Clinical Excellence.

---

## Home

A very warm welcome to YourGP@Lyneham.

Our practice vision is 'Genuine Care, Clinical Excellence'.

The best medicine is provided in the context of a long-term relationship with your GP. This relationship allows your GP to grow in understanding of who you are, your medical history and what is important to you. In this setting your GP can best tailor treatment to you and your circumstances, caring for you as a whole person. You can grow in trust of your GP, in their knowledge and genuine care for you and your family. Many GPs have established relationships with patients that cover decades. Some have the privilege of caring for four generations of the same family. These are relationships your GP would like to build with you.

Your GP provides clinical excellence through:
- Staying up to date with advances in medicine
- Fully computerised records and other technologies to support comprehensive care
- Continuing practice quality improvements
- Teaching the next generation of doctors by participating in the training of medical students and new GPs

Most importantly, your GP wishes to take the time to listen and explain. Your GP aims for people to leave with questions answered and a better understanding of their own health.

### Opening Hours

**Lyneham**: Monday to Thursday 8:00am–6:00pm, Friday 8:00am–12:00pm

### Locations

## Services

### Children's Health
Paediatrics is a special interest of the GPs. Kids love to visit. The GPs and nurses all enjoy seeing children.

### Childhood Immunisations
GPs and nurses are supportive of childhood vaccinations. They are safe and an effective way to protect your child. Immunisation records are uploaded electronically to the Australian Immunisation Register.

### Chronic Disease Management
GPs are highly experienced at helping patients with:
1. Cardiovascular disease including myocardial infarction (heart attack) and post-MI care; valvular heart disease; hypertension (high blood pressure); heart failure.
2. Type 2 Diabetes both new-onset and established.
3. Osteoarthritis.
4. Chronic Kidney disease Stages 1 through 4.
5. Autoimmune diseases including rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and psoriatic arthritis.

### Driver's Medicals
Commercial driving medical assessments require a double length appointment. For non-commercial licences for chronic medical conditions book a standard appointment.

### Men's Health
Check-ups, erectile dysfunction, incontinence, vasectomy, mental health, STI screens. For more information on vasectomies, please see the vasectomy section.

### Mental Health
Depression, anxiety, postnatal depression, schizophrenia, grief, bipolar depression and PTSD. A mental health care plan (referral to a psychologist) requires a double appointment.

### Minor Procedures
Implanon insertion and removal, IUD insertion and removal, skin cancer removal, tongue tie, ingrown toenail removal, vasectomy (Dr John Deery only). Not all procedures are done by all doctors — please call the practice to find the doctor best suited to help you.

### IUD Insertion
Dr Roslyn Mackenzie at YourGP@Crace. This involves a visit to discuss IUD suitability and then a separate appointment for insertion.

### Musculoskeletal
Diagnosis and assessment of all types of joint and muscle sprains and strains.

### Tongue Tie
Dr John Deery only. Tongue tie is a common condition of newborn children. It will sometimes cause newborns to have a lot of difficulty with breastfeeding. He can provide prompt assessment and treatment of the condition, on the same day, when appropriate. Lip tie concerns are common and will rarely need surgical correction. If concerned please book for assessment.

### Travel Vaccinations
Yellow fever vaccine is available at Denman with Dr Anna Colwell or at Crace with Dr Krystel Chin and Dr Penny Gosling. Please bring any previous immunisation records.

### Skin Checks
Skin checks require a long appointment. Please do not wear make-up.

### Vasectomy
Initial consult with Dr John Deery at either Lyneham or Denman. The procedure is performed at Crace only on Thursday and Friday mornings. See canberravasectomy.com.au for more information.

### Women's Health
Check-ups, pap smears, STI screens, breast check, contraceptive advice, implanon insertion and removal, IUD insertion, menopause, pregnancy planning, shared antenatal care and postnatal check-ups.

### Workers Compensation
Payment is required at the time of your appointment. Standard consultation charges apply. Your insurer will reimburse you.

### After Hours
After hours services are contained on the new patient page. See https://www.yourgplyneham.com.au/patient/ for details.

### Allied Health

**Nursing**: Immunisations, ear syringe, wound management, health assessments, ECG, iron infusions, diabetes clinics, health assessments and chronic disease care plans. Bookings only available by calling reception.

**Pathology**: 4Cyte Pathology are located next door. Opening hours: Monday and Wednesday to Friday 7:30am–2:00pm, Tuesday 8:00am–11:00am.

---

## New Patient

### Your first visit at YourGP@Lyneham

Save time waiting in the practice by completing your new patient registration online via HotDoc. Please arrive at least ten minutes early to your first appointment. This will give you sufficient time to fill out forms and for reception to create your new patient file.

### Billing and Appointments

Payment is required at time of consultation. The GPs do not bulk bill.

All Workers Compensation cases are required to pay at time of consultation. Third Party (case conference) consultations will be billed to the insurer if there is an accepted claim number.

If a procedure or any other type of appointment is made then fees will be advised prior.

YourGP@Crace is open most Saturday mornings from 9am to 1pm. Saturday appointments attract higher fees. Please book online at yourgpcrace.com.au or call 6109 0000.

GPs reserve some appointments daily for urgent bookings. You can secure an 'on the day' appointment by booking online from midnight or by calling from 8:00am.

If you wish to cancel your appointment please give as much notice as possible. Missed appointments will attract a $50 fee for a standard appointment and $100 for a long appointment.

There is a cancellation list which you can place yourself on by booking online or by calling reception.

#### Fees

- Level B Consultation (<20min): $117
- Level C Consultation (<40min): $213
- Level D Consultation (<60min): $317
- Level E Consultation (>60min): $459

#### Saturday Fees (at YourGP@Crace)

- Level B Consultation (<20min): $146
- Level C Consultation (<40min): $240
- Level D Consultation (<60min): $364
- Level E Consultation (>60min): $488

### After Hours

Practice opening hours are 8am to 6pm Monday to Thursday, 8am to 12pm Friday. A Saturday morning Crace clinic opens from 9am to 1pm.

For attention outside these hours please call CALMS on 1300 422 567. CALMS (Canberra Afterhours Locum Service) is staffed by experienced Canberra GPs. It is a not for profit organisation that has been operating since 1971. When you call you will speak with a nurse who will triage your medical problem. They may advise that it would be acceptable to wait and see your regular GP the following day.

If they advise you to see your GP the following day please access one of our emergency on the day bookings. These appointments become available online after midnight or by calling from 7:45am.

CALMS is only open afterhours:
- 6pm–8:30am Monday to Friday
- 24 hours on weekends and public holidays

CALMS clinics operate until 11pm at North Canberra Hospital Bruce and The Canberra Hospital. After 11pm a doctor is available to visit at home if you need urgent attention. CALMS send the practice consultation notes the following morning so your GP is informed of your care. CALMS charge a fee which will be advised on booking. If you have a health care card or concession card the fees are reduced.

Healthdirect — 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. If you have a health issue and you do not know who to contact or what to do, a registered nurse will help direct you. Phone 1800 022 222.

YourGP afterhours care:
- Option 1 — Saturday morning clinic at YourGP@Crace by appointment.
- Option 2 — Urgent after hours care at all other times. This option is available to regular patients only. It requires prepayment of $300 and will start with a phone consultation. If it is deemed safe and necessary, an in person consultation will then be scheduled.

Walk-in Nurse Centres — 7:30am to 10pm. No appointment needed.

---

## FAQ

### Making Appointments
It is easy to book online. If you wish to call, please advise which practice you would like to visit and your preferred GP. Your usual GP prefers to see you for continuity of care. If your usual GP is not available, you are welcome to see another GP at Crace, Denman or Lyneham. They will have full access to your computer record. Your regular GP will be able to view that consultation at your next visit. If you think your appointment will require longer than fifteen minutes, please book a long appointment. If you wish to book a skin check or a mental health care plan, please advise reception so they can make the appropriate length appointment. If you wish to cancel your appointment, please give as much notice as possible. Missed appointments without notice will attract a $50 fee for a standard appointment and $100 for a long appointment.

### Urgent Bookings
A proportion of appointments are reserved for urgent bookings each day. You can secure an 'on the day' appointment by booking online after midnight or by calling from 8am. If fully booked, we will try to find an appointment for you if your need is urgent. When fully booked, you can request a fit-in appointment. You can book on the fit-in list online.

### Billing
Payment is required at the time of consultation. The GPs do not bulk bill. Consultation fees: Level B (<20min): $117; Level C (<40min): $213; Level D (<60min): $317; Level E (>60min): $459. Saturday fees: Level B: $146; Level C: $240; Level D: $364; Level E: $488. If a procedure or any other appointment is made, fees will be advised beforehand. All Workers' Compensation/Third Party cases are required to pay at the consultation time. Missed appointments will attract a $50 fee for a standard appointment and $100 for a long appointment. Further appointments will not be able to be made until the missed appointment fee is paid in full.

### Parking
There is plentiful parking around the Lyneham shops. There is also parking opposite Lyneham Primary School on Brigalow St. Alternately drive past the practice and turn right at the roundabout onto Wattle Street — there is all day parking on the right side of the street.

### Languages
English. A phone interpreter can be provided if necessary — please advise the language spoken and preferably give a few days notice to organise an interpreter. Deaf patients can use the National Relay Service or Auslan interpreters.

### Confidentiality
Your privacy is very important to us. Patient information is kept confidential. You may request the full privacy policy from reception or access it at the bottom of the webpage.

### Medical Certificates
A medical certificate is a legal document. Certificates cannot be backdated. Certificates will not be issued unless your GP is consulted.

### Results
The majority of results are notified via SMS. Any urgent results will be notified via phone call. Your results will be available online to view through your MyHealthRecord or MyDHR. ACT Pathology results are available to view immediately through MyDHR or the MyHealthRecord. Capital Pathology and Laverty Pathology results are available to view through your MyHealthRecord 7 days after the results have been processed. 4Cyte Pathology are not currently sending results to the MyHealthRecord.

### Contacting Your Doctor
Your GP can be contacted during business hours. Your GP will generally not take phone calls — you may leave a message. Please where possible let reception know what your call is regarding.

### Repeat Prescriptions
Your GP requests that you attend for review for a repeat prescription. This is best practice medicine. At your doctor's discretion a repeat prescription may be done without an appointment. This will be done in exceptional circumstances. An administration fee of $30 will apply. Please allow four working days.

### E-mail
E-mail to reception is not secure. Please take care in disclosing confidential information. To send a message to your doctor we request that you use the contact form, located in the Contact page of the website. Documents for your doctor can be sent to noreply@yourgpcanberra.com.au.

### Reminders
Your GP values preventative health care. You will be notified via SMS of reminders when due.

### After Hours Care
Canberra Afterhours Locum Medical Service (CALMS) provide excellent after hours care. Please call 1300 422 567. CALMS will send a summary via secure email of any visits that you have.

Healthdirect — 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. If you have a health issue and you do not know who to contact or what to do, a registered nurse will help direct you. Phone 1800 022 222.

YourGP afterhours care:
- Option 1 — Saturday morning clinic at YourGP@Crace by appointment.
- Option 2 — Urgent after hours care at all other times, click on Afterhours link on the right side bar. This option is available to regular patients only. It requires prepayment of $300 and will start with a phone consultation. If it is deemed safe and necessary, an in person consultation will then be scheduled.

Walk-in Nurse Centres — 7:30am to 10pm. No appointment needed.

### Accreditation
Accredited with AGPAL (Australian General Practice Accreditation Limited).

### Teaching Practice
YourGP is a teaching practice. Third year medical students from the ANU sit in with our GPs. We host one student in the practice for six week rotations, six times each year. Medical students appreciate participating in your care. If your GP has a medical student you will be advised. You may decline to have a medical student present during your consultation.

We also teach and provide supervision to GP registrars. A registrar is a fully qualified doctor who is undertaking further training in General Practice. Registrars have several years postgraduate experience in the hospital system. General practice training involves two years of work under a GP supervisor. Registrars are required to sit the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners fellowship exams.

### Suggestions or Complaints
Suggestions about how to improve our service are appreciated. The best way to provide feedback is via the 'contact us' form on the contact page. If we are unable to resolve your complaint you may make an official complaint to the Community & Healthcare Complaints Commissioner, GPO Box 321, Canberra ACT 2601.

### Privacy Policy
Your privacy is important to us. Our full privacy policy (reviewed February 2026) is available on our Privacy Policy page, or you may request a copy from reception.

## Careers

### Join One of Canberra's Leading GP Practices

We're actively recruiting excellent GPs, nurses, and admin team members.

We care deeply about the people we serve. We pursue excellence every day. We continually seek to improve. We want to be the best.

3 Clinics | 33 Consulting Rooms | 30,000+ Patients per Year

### Why GPs Choose YourGP

We exist to serve GPs — so you can focus on what matters: your patients.

**Designed for Doctors**
- All consulting rooms at Crace have views to the outside — clinics designed so doctors actually want to work in them
- Surgical theatre space and nurse treatment rooms across all sites
- AI transcription tools available — camera and microphone in every room

**Clinical Excellence and Mentorship**
- Strong skin cancer, minor surgery, and joint injection team with mentorship available
- Develop your special interests — your patient panel reflects how you practise
- Preferred training location for GP registrars in Canberra

**Your Practice, Your Way**
- GPs are tenants hiring us to provide services and facilities so they can serve their patients
- Complete freedom — no lock-in contracts, no set hours, no pressure
- Excellent admin and nursing support so you can focus on patients
- You have full control over your hours and leave

**Strong Financials**
- 1.5% DNA rate — your time is respected
- Competitive service fee with strong billing discipline
- GP satisfaction surveyed every four months — we measure what matters
- Full financial details in the GP Information Pack — express your interest to receive it

**DPA Locations Available**
- Two of our three clinics (Crace and Denman) are in a Distribution Priority Area
- Visa sponsorship available for eligible international medical graduates

### What Your Day Looks Like as a GP

When you first join, we start you with a reduced patient load — as few as 2–3 patients per hour — so you have time to learn our systems and settle in. We then gradually increase your patient flow as you're ready. Our established GPs typically see 3–4 patients per hour.

Your patients already trust our brand, so about 80% of the trust gap is covered before you meet them. We'll help you create an introduction video so patients can see your personality before they book — this builds rapport before the first consultation.

We provide full administrative and nursing support. Our admin team handles billing, bookings, and correspondence. Our nursing team provides clinical support, patient preparation, and health coaching. You focus on medicine.

We do not currently have capacity for Level 1 Supervision for overseas trained doctors requiring supervision.

### Nurses

Are you a fantastic nurse who loves helping people and is always looking to improve? We might be the right place for you.

Our nursing team are integral to the care we provide to patients and GPs. You'll have varied days with a lot of face-to-face patient time, health coaching, and clinical support.

We invest in our team — minimum 20 hours of professional development per year, cross-training opportunities, and a supportive culture where you're valued.

To thrive here, you enjoy helping others with care and excellence, and you're always looking to improve.

### Admin Team

Our GPs see over 30,000 patients a year across three clinics. A lot of support is required for the clinical team to deliver this level of care — and that's where you come in.

You'll be the first point of contact for patients, the backbone of GP support, and a key part of how we deliver an excellent experience every day.

Qualities that will see you thrive in this role:
1. You like learning and doing new things.
2. You get energised by helping others.
3. You have excellent attention to detail.

We invest in our people — training, career pathways, and a workplace where you're supported to do your best work.

## Privacy Policy

YourGP is committed to protecting the privacy of your personal information and health information. This privacy policy explains how we manage your personal information and complies with the requirements of the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth), the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs), and the Health Records (Privacy and Access) Act 1997 (ACT). This policy was reviewed in February 2026.

When you register as a patient of our practice, you provide consent for our GPs and practice staff to access and use your personal information so they can provide you with the best possible healthcare. Only staff who need to see your personal information will have access to it.

We collect your personal information to provide you with the highest level of healthcare. We may also use it to manage your ongoing healthcare and communicate with other healthcare providers, remind you of upcoming appointments, process claims through Medicare, DVA, or your private health fund, comply with legal obligations including mandatory reporting, and improve our services through clinical audits.

The information we collect may include names, date of birth, addresses, contact details, medical information including history, medications, allergies, adverse events, immunisations, social history, family history, risk factors, Medicare number, DVA number, private health fund details, healthcare identifiers, and clinical photographs where relevant with your consent.

We may share your personal information with other healthcare providers involved in your care, with Medicare, DVA, or your private health fund for billing, when required by law, or when necessary to lessen or prevent a serious threat to health or safety. Some administrative and support functions are performed by staff based in Malaysia, bound by strict confidentiality agreements and the same privacy obligations as Australian-based staff.

Our practice may use AI-powered clinical scribes to assist doctors with documentation during consultations. Your informed consent is obtained before any AI scribe is activated. Audio recordings are destroyed immediately after the clinical note is generated. No patient data is stored or processed outside Australia. All personally identifiable information is removed from any data used for AI model improvement.

We store personal information in electronic and paper-based records with security measures including access-controlled clinical software, locked filing cabinets, secure IT infrastructure, and confidentiality agreements for all staff and contractors.

You have the right to request access to, or correction of, your personal information. Please submit a written request and we will respond within 30 days. An administration fee may apply.

To lodge a privacy complaint, contact us at admin@ygp.au, by post to any YourGP location, or by phone on 02 6109 0000. We will investigate and respond within 30 days. If not satisfied, you may lodge a complaint with the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC) on 1300 363 992 or at www.oaic.gov.au.

The full privacy policy is available at https://www.yourgplyneham.com.au/privacy-policy/
